_readme: Videos chosen for each lesson. 'why' is shown to the learner. 'expect' lists words the captions must contain; pipeline/check_videos.py refuses a video that is missing, cannot be embedded, or does not cover them. Run: pipeline/.venv/Scripts/python pipeline/check_videos.py
